images.prompt: Photorealistic macro photograph of a handcrafted miniature tabletop diorama. A small home desk of matte graphite with chamfered corners sits on a pale neutral tabletop, holding a slim graphite laptop slab, a cold mug and a neat stack of ivory card notes. Across the desk, a second graphite chair points toward it, and on that chair sits a plain ivory stress ball about the size of a grapefruit, the only other presence in the room. A single acid-lime sticky note is pressed onto the ball, blank, as if left for it. A frosted acrylic lamp glows on the desk, and a jacket hangs unused on a hook by the door. Dust has gathered on the chair opposite, and the note's edge curls slightly. Wide 16:9 landscape frame. The hero object sits slightly left of centre on the lower third, with the related objects extending to the right so the workflow reads left to right. Clean, generous negative space above. Shot as a real physical model, not a 3D render. Materials are limited and tactile: heavyweight ivory cotton paper and card with visible fibres, soft folds and slightly deckled edges; matte, bead-blasted graphite metal with fine machining lines, chamfered edges and tiny hex fasteners; frosted acrylic with milky edges and a soft internal glow; sandblasted frosted glass. Surfaces carry believable imperfections: fine dust, paper grain, hairline creases, light scuffs on metal. Every object has convincing miniature scale and weight and rests firmly on its surface. Colour palette is restrained and nearly monochrome: white #FFFFFF, warm ivory, pale neutral #F3F5F2, soft grey-green #DCE1DA, muted graphite #626A64 and deep graphite #191D1B. Acid lime #D0F344 appears only on the lime element named in the scene, as the single signal colour, with olive #718D0B on its shadowed sides. Nothing else is lime or saturated; no red, orange or blue accents. Lighting: one large soft key light from the upper left at about 45 degrees, like diffused north-window daylight, with a gentle white bounce fill from the right; soft grounded contact shadows fall to the lower right. Camera: 100mm macro lens at f/4, eye level with the tabletop, three-quarter view. The hero object is tack sharp and the background melts into smooth, creamy blur on a seamless pale neutral sweep. Mood: calm, precise, orderly and quietly premium, like high-end editorial product photography. Strictly no people, figures, faces, hands or silhouettes. No readable text, letters, numbers, clock digits, logos, signage or user-interface graphics anywhere. No holograms, floating screens, robots with faces, dense cable tangles, carnival or circus elements, cartoon or plastic CGI look, oversaturated colour, lens flare or heavy vignette.

Photorealistic macro photograph of a handcrafted miniature tabletop diorama, captured mid-disaster. Isolation has piled up around the same ball. Ivory sticky notes cover the desk, the laptop and the opposite chair in overlapping layers, and fresh notes are frozen mid-air, falling from a toppled stack. The acid-lime note is now half buried among ivory ones stuck all over the ball, which has rolled to the edge of its chair seat and is tipping forward. A trail of notes runs from the desk across the floor toward the door, where the jacket has slipped off its hook. The mug has filled with notes. Paper curls and dust drift in the lamp light, all spreading out from the chair opposite. Wide 16:9 landscape frame, same layout and angle as the calm version of this scene. The hero object stays slightly left of centre, and the spread of the disaster runs to the right and toward the camera so its path can be traced back to the source. Nothing else is lime or saturated; no red, orange or blue accents. Photorealistic photograph of a vast handcrafted miniature landscape diorama. A small island of pale ivory sand rises from a wide still sea of milky frosted water, with a thin horizon line and a faint shoreline far away where graphite office towers stand. The island is built from the ruins of the home office: the desk lies half sunk in the sand at the size of a reef, the chair opposite is a weathered frame, and the ivory ball rests at the water's edge, bleached and pitted. Drifts of faded notes cover the dunes. A slim graphite raft-building rig on the shore has lashed desk panels into a flat raft and is raising a lime sail on a thin mast, pointed toward the distant towers. Wide 16:9 panoramic frame. The main ruin anchors the left or centre foreground, terrain rolls back to a distant horizon on the upper third, and the lime recovery rig sits in the right midground. Surfaces carry believable imperfections: fine dust, paper grain, hairline creases, light scuffs on metal. Every object has convincing miniature scale and weight and rests firmly on its surface.
